# Standard mileage rate or actual expenses in 2026?

> Free calculator comparing the 2026 IRS standard mileage rate (72.5 cents per mile through June 30, 76 cents from July 1) with actual vehicle expenses for a self-employed business car. See which deduction is larger and what it is worth. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it answers

The 2026 IRS standard mileage rate for business use is 72.5 cents a mile for miles driven January 1 to June 30 and 76 cents a mile from July 1 to December 31, so a year of miles cannot be multiplied by one rate. Business parking and tolls are deductible on top. Source: IRS, "Standard mileage rates" (IR-2025-128 and IR-2026-29). As of 2026-11-14.
